summary: Add store acceptance cases for checked membership pages across replication, lifecycle edits and root/folder keyset ties

replay.detail: Tests use committed local edits and the existing replication/projector fixture; production replay behavior is unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema or generated client changes.

rules.detail: Cases assert unchanged collection state after other-arrangement, unreferenced-resource and irrelevant imported writes; relevant imports, placement, removal, count-preserving reorder, effective-bucket changes and retirement advance the selected frontier.

compatibility.detail: Tests exercise the existing checked atomic page API and terminal metadata across root/folder tuple ties. They do not establish HTTP error mapping, host-switch handling, restored-database boot epochs or client publication behavior. No capability is advertised.

manual.detail: No manual steps. These added tests have not been run as part of this change.

recovery.detail: Existing generation rollback, unchanged-index repair/rebuild and reopen coverage is retained without duplication.
